Six thousand credits on success. Then we can deal with the depot.

Let's give our drivers their road back.

lines.text: The junction is open. Now we put freight through the corridor. Land at the staging apron and clear Dispatch Post, East Crossing, and Outbound Gate. lines.text: Crew has Wayward again. You're back on the company net, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: [warm] Crew has Wayward again. You're back on the company net, Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Wayward's down. Keep the company moving. Secure the depot and I'll arrange recovery with Venn. We can mend a chassis.
lines.synthesisText: [firm] Wayward's down. Keep the company moving. Secure the depot and I'll arrange recovery with Venn. We can mend a chassis.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Mara, one item before you close the docket. Wayward is still listed as scrap on your manifest. We'd like the chassis and its fitted chaingun.
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] Mara, one item before you close the docket. Wayward is still listed as scrap on your manifest. We'd like the chassis and its fitted chaingun.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: That scrap used to guard my drivers, Castle. If I sign her over, your company takes on the maintenance. I'm trying to run a freight cooperative.
lines.synthesisText: [dryly amused] That scrap used to guard my drivers, Castle. If I sign her over, your company takes on the maintenance. I'm trying to run a freight cooperative.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Fair. Wayline covers recovery and this repair; we take her upkeep from handover. Put that beside the contract fee, and I'll sign.
lines.synthesisText: [confident] Fair. Wayline covers recovery and this repair; we take her upkeep from handover. Put that beside the contract fee, and I'll sign.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Agreed. Wayward is repaired and signed over, chaingun included. No missiles in those mounts. We'll provide heavy lift on the supply-route jobs. Give her a good home, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: [warm] Agreed. Wayward is repaired and signed over, chaingun included. No missiles in those mounts. We'll provide heavy lift on the supply-route jobs. Give her a good home, Captain.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Agreed. We've recovered Wayward's wreck and repaired the chassis. She's yours, chaingun included. No missiles in those mounts. We'll provide heavy lift on the supply-route jobs. Give her a good home, Captain.
lines.synthesisText: [warm] Agreed. We've recovered Wayward's wreck and repaired the chassis. She's yours, chaingun included. No missiles in those mounts. We'll provide heavy lift on the supply-route jobs. Give her a good home, Captain.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Hegemony patrol, this is Mara Venn for Wayline. We've traced attacks on our freighters to an installation on Garnir. Requesting a patrol diversion.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike, quietly confident] Hegemony patrol, this is Mara Venn for Wayline. We've traced attacks on our freighters to an installation on Garnir. Requesting a patrol diversion.

lines.text: Wayline, Captain Kord, Resolute. Your hired company's report is not sufficient grounds to alter fleet patrols. Transmit verifiable evidence of pirate operations.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Wayline, Captain Kord, Resolute. Your hired company's report is not sufficient grounds to alter fleet patrols. Transmit verifiable evidence of pirate operations.

lines.text: Sable Wake's dispatch archive is inside that compound. Our contractors can retrieve the original traffic records, with authentication intact.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike, persuasive] Sable Wake's dispatch archive is inside that compound. Our contractors can retrieve the original traffic records, with authentication intact.

lines.text: Transmit the archive when you have it. Until it is authenticated, our patrol orders stand.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Transmit the archive when you have it. Until it is authenticated, our patrol orders stand.

lines.text: Captain, we're on the ground. Dispatch office is marked. Secure those records intact; Venn needs more than our word to bring that patrol in.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [composed, focused] Captain, we're on the ground. Dispatch office is marked. Secure those records intact; Venn needs more than our word to bring that patrol in.

lines.text: Captain, our people are closing on dispatch. Get a squad inside and hold the office while they secure the archive.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [firm, focused] Captain, our people are closing on dispatch. Get a squad inside and hold the office while they secure the archive.

lines.text: Resolute, this is Wayline. Sable Wake's dispatch archive, intact. The company secured it for you. That should settle the question of who owns this place.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike, quietly confident] Resolute, this is Wayline. Sable Wake's dispatch archive, intact. The company secured it for you. That should settle the question of who owns this place.

lines.text: Captain Kord, HSS Resolute. Authentication accepted. Pirate installation confirmed. Gunnery, prepare a demolition pattern.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Captain Kord, HSS Resolute. Authentication accepted. Pirate installation confirmed. Gunnery, prepare a demolition pattern.

lines.text: Resolute, acknowledge our withdrawal. Resolute? ... Damn it. Captain, those guns are training on the compound. Get our people out. Now.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [tense, trying to sound composed] Resolute, acknowledge our withdrawal. Resolute? ... [strained, quickening] Damn it. Captain, those guns are training on the compound. [urgent, tightly controlled fear] Get our people out. Now.

lines.text: Gunnery. Commence bombardment.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Gunnery. Commence bombardment.

lines.text: Incoming! Keep moving. Get to the shuttles! We are not losing anyone to this.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [urgent, strained, struggling to keep control] Incoming! Keep moving. Get to the shuttles! [firm, fear beneath the command] We are not losing anyone to this.

lines.text: Continue through the remaining structures. Leave nothing operational.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Continue through the remaining structures. Leave nothing operational.

lines.text: Installation neutralized. Resuming patrol.
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN IRENA KORD / HSS RESOLUTE
lines.synthesisText: [firm, authoritative] Installation neutralized. Resuming patrol.

lines.text: Mara. Did you hear her? Straight from authentication to a demolition order. Not one word about our people.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, shaken, holding composure] Mara. Did you hear her? Straight from authentication to a demolition order. Not one word about our people.

lines.text: I thought giving her the archive would buy us some consideration. She wanted coordinates and proof. Once she had them, we were background traffic.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [subdued, rueful] I thought giving her the archive would buy us some consideration. She wanted coordinates and proof. Once she had them, we were background traffic.

lines.text: One ship, and that whole installation becomes a gunnery problem. We finally have something worth keeping. She could have erased it without learning our name.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, unsettled] One ship, and that whole installation becomes a gunnery problem. We finally have something worth keeping. She could have erased it without learning our name.

lines.text: I know your name, Castle. So do the people whose work you made possible. Kord needed our proof. That did not put your company under her protection.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [sober, sincere] I know your name, Castle. So do the people whose work you made possible. Kord needed our proof. That did not put your company under her protection.

lines.text: Then we remember that. Take the contract, get paid, keep a way out. Nobody mistakes being useful for being protected.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured, regaining resolve] Then we remember that. Take the contract, get paid, keep a way out. Nobody mistakes being useful for being protected.

lines.text: And we keep what we earned. You broke Sable Wake's operation against us. Wayline owes you for that, and I intend to keep hiring you. We'll build from here with our eyes open.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, resolute] And we keep what we earned. You broke Sable Wake's operation against us. Wayline owes you for that, and I intend to keep hiring you. We'll build from here with our eyes open.

lines.text: When we met, I was trying to keep one depot. You found the people watching our routes and took their listening post away. We get to choose the next move, Captain.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [warm, quietly proud] When we met, I was trying to keep one depot. You found the people watching our routes and took their listening post away. We get to choose the next move, Captain.

lines.text: We can reach them, and we know how to prepare. First we account for our people and put the company in order. Then we take the next contract on our terms.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured, quietly confident] We can reach them, and we know how to prepare. First we account for our people and put the company in order. Then we take the next contract on our terms.

lines.text: Kestrel to ground team. Wayline sent us ahead. Keep moving; we will work the next position.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Kestrel, on station. We have the road. Your militia can move up behind the company.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Kestrel is staying over the militia while they settle in. Push on when your people are ready.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE

lines.text: Taking fire up here. Keep those emplacements off us.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Kestrel is down. Keep clear of the impact. The company will have to open the rest of the junction.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Kestrel is heading home. Good work down there.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Kestrel again, Captain. Same crew, longer road. Coming up to cover the convoy.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: We have the column. Starting our circuit.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Missile hit! Launchers on the northern ridgeline. They have our circuit.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Kestrel is down! Stay clear of the wreck. Those ridge batteries had our circuit. Keep the company moving; the convoy still needs this road.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: Kestrel clear of the corridor. Bringing her home. The road is yours, Captain.
lines.speaker: KESTREL / WAYLINE AIR

lines.text: Captain, Morrow is moving under her own power. Keep the company ahead of her and clear that pump bend.
lines.synthesisText: [pleased, focused] Captain, Morrow is moving under her own power. Keep the company ahead of her and clear that pump bend.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: My first militia team is in position at the pump bend, Captain. Bring your company forward when you're ready.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, reassuring] My first militia team is in position at the pump bend, Captain. Bring your company forward when you're ready.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION

lines.text: My second militia team is holding the narrows, Captain. Keep the company with Morrow for the climb-out.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, reassuring] My second militia team is holding the narrows, Captain. Keep the company with Morrow for the climb-out.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
